attack.note: Twenty-two attack drawings generated with gpt-image-2.5-sunburst (imagegen CLI edit, quality high, native alpha, 1536x1024, --no-augment): the original six (crouch, lunge, stab, slash, follow, recover), eight added so that no cut jumps the head more than about a head and a half and the feet step instead of skating (coil, dash1-dash3, rise0, rise, skip, land), and eight more so that no cut moves the head or the near-hand dagger more than about two and a half head lengths and the dash is carried by flight drawings (dash1b take-off, air and air2 the near arm swinging forward before touchdown, thrust the half-extended arm between lunge and stab, swing1 to swing3 the arm coming down out of the rising cut, skipb the descent of the retreat hop). Sources are the exact lossless model outputs; scripts/animation/monogatari_silent.py bakes them (registration: scripts/animation/sources/monogatari_silent/attack-registration.json; `lift` raises the airborne drawings, `shift` places a drawing with no sole to plant). The registration tracks the NEAR (ring-hand) dagger in every drawing, tip first. The ready drawing and idle loop derive from monogatari_silent-hero.webp.
